title: Orchestrated Cutover Scheduler and Ownership Roster for Multi-Surface Rollouts
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an operational schedule and lightweight automation that coordinates cutovers across Runtime, Console, and API surfaces. Deliverables: a shared calendar (timeboxed cohorts by region), an ownership roster for cutover windows, automated gating checks (latency/error/capacity), and an on-call escalation sheet. Purpose: reduce manual coordination overhead during releases, shorten mean time to safe cutover, and ensure consistent rollback triggers across teams. This ticket ties to OKR 'Improve multi-surface release reliability' and will be used in upcoming runtime-1.24 and console-2026.03 rollouts.
comments: 2026-02-14 - PM sync: Defined success metrics for cutover: P50 < target by cohort, P95 < 2x baseline, error rate delta < 0.5%, and capacity headroom >= 20% before promoting cohort. Action: Eng to implement gating API endpoints returning pass/fail payload.
